IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'DomainSetting') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[DomainSetting]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [IdpSsoEndpoint] [varchar](1000) NOT NULL, [IdpSloEndpoint] [varchar](1000) NOT NULL, [IdpDomainCertificateID] [int] NULL, [SpDomainCertificateID] [int] NULL, [HashAlgorithmType] [int] NOT NULL, [SignInitialSSORequest] [bit] constraint DF_DomainSetting_SignInitialSSORequest default(0) NOT NULL, [AuthenticationSettings] [varchar](4000) constraint DF_DomainSetting_AuthenticationSettings default('{}') NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_DomainSetting] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'DomainSetting' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AuthenticationSettings') begin ALTER TABLE dbo.DomainSetting add AuthenticationSettings varchar(4000) constraint DF_DomainSetting_AuthenticationSettings default('{}') not null end
